question: A hostel had 206 blankets in its store and sent 62 of them away for repair. Every blanket still in the store is stitched from 7 fabric panels. A box in the cupboard holds another 60 spare panels of the same kind. The housekeeper then used 127 panels to patch curtains around the building. How many panels does the hostel have?

Yara had 101 tiles in her workshop, and her partner Sam brought 59 more, fewer than Yara already had. Every one of those tiles was cut into 4 squares. Each square carries 4 small studs on its back. During the move 606 studs snapped off and were lost. A cleaner found 8 loose studs under the bench and added them to the box, and the workshop counts its stock in single studs rather than in packs. How many studs does the workshop have?

On Saturday morning a farm split 216 sacks of grain equally between its 2 barns. Later that morning 46 more sacks were delivered to the north barn. Every sack in the north barn holds 8 scoops of grain. In the afternoon 83 scoops were fed to the chickens, and a miller collected 432 scoops. That evening the farmer valued every scoop still in the north barn at 5 pence. How many pence is the north barn's grain worth?

A museum gift shop had 227 postcards in stock, and 1 was torn and thrown away. The rest were divided equally between the shop's 2 counters. The front counter sold 78 postcards on Saturday. A printer then delivered 74 new postcards to the front counter. How many postcards are on the front counter?

On Monday morning a workshop had 131 metres of copper wire on the reel. A delivery added 7 metres before lunch, and the offcut bin gave up 5 more metres. In the afternoon 84 metres were used on a rewiring job. Every metre still in the workshop can be cut into 8 short leads, and the workshop measures its wire in metres rather than in centimetres. How many short leads can the workshop cut?

On Monday morning a school store held 226 boxes of pencils, and 62 boxes were sent over to the new building. In the afternoon every box left in the store was opened, and each one held 6 pencils. Those pencils were shared equally among the school's 6 classes. Each pencil comes with 4 spare leads in its case, and the school counts its supplies in single pencils rather than in boxes. How many spare leads did one class receive?

On Monday morning a bottling plant had 137 crates in the yard, and a delivery brought 46 more. Every crate holds 9 boxes, and each box holds 6 jars. The plant has 3 loading bays, and a dozen staff work on the line. In the afternoon a supermarket bought 2666 jars. That evening 13 jars came back from a damaged pallet. How many jars are in the yard now?

On Friday morning a hotel had 163 clean pillowcases, and 3 of them were torn and binned. Before lunch the laundry returned 72 more. In the afternoon all the pillowcases were divided equally between the hotel's 2 wings, and the east wing took its share upstairs. That evening a delivery brought 21 extra pillowcases to the east wing. How many pillowcases does the east wing have?

A council bought 228 saplings and split them equally between its 2 parks. Every sapling planted in the north park was fastened to its stake with 9 plastic ties. The store shed held another 14 ties of exactly the same kind. The maintenance team then took 737 ties away for work in the town centre. How many ties are left for the north park?

On Saturday morning a bakery had 51 trays in the kitchen and sent 45 of them out to the market. In the afternoon each tray still in the kitchen was fitted with 2 racks. Every rack was then filled with 9 buns. That evening 2 buns were burnt and thrown away. How many buns did the bakery have?

A tea factory puts 53 bags into every packet, and each box holds 4 packets. A case is filled with 5 of those boxes, and one case was set aside for a hotel. A worker added 42 loose bags to that case, and then 229 bags were found damp and thrown out. The factory has been running for 70 years, and half of its staff work nights. Each bag left in the case makes 9 cups of tea, and every cup holds 3 ounces, since the hotel measures its drinks in ounces rather than in pints. How many ounces of tea can that case make?

On Monday morning a nursery potted 158 seedlings, and in the afternoon it potted exactly the same number again, so 2 equal batches stood in the greenhouse. That evening a colleague brought in 33 more seedlings. Every seedling in the greenhouse grew 8 shoots over the summer. Each shoot opened 8 leaves. The greenhouse has 24 panes of glass. By autumn 14434 of those leaves had fallen. How many leaves were still on the plants?

A publisher prints 38 pages in every booklet. Each folder holds 6 booklets, each crate holds 3 folders, and each pallet holds 8 crates. The lorry that left on Tuesday carried 8 identical pallets. A clerk added 72 loose pages to the load at the last minute. The lorry itself is 14 metres long. How many pages were on the lorry?

A gym had 93 lockers in its old changing room and added 7 more. A second changing room was then built with exactly the same number of lockers, so the gym now has 2 identical rooms. Each locker holds 7 towels. The gym has 3 swimming lanes in the pool. A cupboard by the door holds another 59 towels, and the gym counts its linen in single towels rather than in bundles. How many towels can the gym hold in total?

On Monday morning a bakery baked 51 loaves in each of its 7 ovens. Before lunch 275 loaves were sold at the counter, and a hotel collected 61 more. The bakery weighs its dough in grams rather than in kilograms, and half of the staff start work at dawn. In the afternoon every loaf still in the shop was cut into 7 thick slices. In the evening each of those slices was cut into 4 fingers for the tasting table. How many fingers of bread did the bakery have?

Selim had 92 flowerpots in his yard. He sold 57 pots at the market, and his sister Dila took 26 for her balcony, fewer than he had sold. Each pot he has left holds 8 bulbs. A tray on the bench holds 36 more bulbs, a sack in the shed holds 64, and a friend brought over 46 in a box. The nursery counts its stock in single bulbs rather than in trays. How many bulbs does Selim have?

A stadium had 130 flags in store, and the club bought 64 more. Every flag is fastened with 4 clips. A box on the shelf holds 9 spare clips of the same type. Each clip costs 7 pence to replace. The main stand seats 12000 people. What is the total cost, in pence, of replacing all of the stadium's clips?

A council had 169 street lamps on the high street and removed 125 old ones. It installed 48 new lamps and put 22 more along the alley. Each lamp holds 4 bulbs. Every bulb uses 9 watts, and the council reports its use in watts rather than in kilowatts. The high street is 700 metres long. How many watts do the lamps use?

Nour picked 77 lemons, and her cousin Sami picked exactly as many, doubling the pile they had between them, so neither of them had more than the other. They sold 147 lemons at the roadside stall, which prices its fruit in cents rather than in dollars. They then threw away 5 bruised lemons. A neighbour gave them 65 lemons from her own tree. How many lemons do they have?

A camp store took in 61 crates of food, and a second delivery doubled the number of crates it held. The crates were then split equally between the 2 camps in the valley. The north camp later received 79 more crates of its own. Every crate holds 4 boxes, and each box holds 4 tins. How many tins does the north camp have?

Rosa knitted 39 hats for the winter fair, and her friend Jonah knitted 44, so Jonah made more hats than Rosa did. They bought 9 beads to decorate every hat. A box was dropped on the stairs and 130 of the beads were lost. A craft shop donated 44 beads, and a school sent another 42. The village hall costs 15 pounds an hour to hire. How many beads do they have now?

A school ordered 5 boxes of exercise books with 61 books in each box. It sent 75 of the books over to the annexe. The stationery cupboard gave up 52 more books, a parent donated 35, and a bookshop added 18. The school has 9 classrooms. How many exercise books does the school have?

Omar had 51 seed trays and gave 39 of them to his neighbour Rina, who ended up with far more trays than he kept. Each tray Omar kept holds 6 seedlings. Slugs then destroyed 64 of his seedlings. Rina tripled the number of seedlings Omar had left by giving him some of her own. Omar planted out 21 seedlings in the garden, and half of the bed is still bare. A friend gave him 6 more seedlings. How many seedlings does Omar have?

A dairy fills 131 bottles on each of its 6 filling lines. The night shift added another 44 bottles to the same batch. Every bottle pours 4 cups, and each cup holds 5 ounces, since the dairy measures its milk in ounces rather than in pints. A dozen inspectors visited the plant that week. How many ounces of milk are in the batch?

A courier drove 80 kilometres on each of the 7 days of her round. Of that distance, 196 kilometres were on private roads and cannot be claimed. The firm pays 5 pence for every kilometre claimed, and expenses are always paid in pence rather than in pounds. Her van is 3 years old. A toll charge of 127 pence was then deducted from her claim. How many pence does the courier receive?
